privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Policy describes how Artem Proskurovskyi (an individual, Poznań, Poland) (the "Operator", "we") collects, uses and protects the personal data of users of the Diklario service available at diklario.com (the "Service"). By using the Service, you agree to this Policy.
s1: Account data: name, e-mail, username, password (encrypted), role (teacher/student), interface language, avatar.
Learning data: groups, lessons, homework, attendance, grades, materials, personal vocabulary, learning tracks and practice results.
Payment data: processed by the payment provider (Paddle); we do not store bank card data. Teachers may provide their own details to receive payments from students.
Technical data: IP address, device and browser type, cookies, error logs.
privacy.s2t: Purposes and legal bases for processing
s2: We process data to: provide and operate the Service, authenticate users, send notifications and emails, provide support, process subscription payments, ensure security and improve the product.
Legal bases (GDPR, Art. 6): performance of a contract (providing the Service), consent (e.g. mailings), legitimate interest (security, analytics), legal obligation.
privacy.s3lead: To operate the Service we use third-party providers that process data on our behalf:
s3: Hosting and database — Neon (PostgreSQL), Railway (backend), Vercel (frontend).
Email — Resend (confirmation emails, notifications, support replies).
Payments — Paddle (merchant of record; handling subscriptions and taxes).
AI features — a third-party model provider (e.g. Groq): task and topic wording is sent for generating quizzes, words and roadmaps (without unnecessary personal data).
privacy.s3end: We do not sell personal data.
privacy.s4: Servers and sub-processors may be located outside your country, including outside the EEA. In such cases, transfers are made with appropriate safeguards (e.g. standard contractual clauses).
privacy.s5: We use strictly necessary cookies for authentication (session, access token) and operation of the Service. Without them, signing in is impossible. Analytics/marketing cookies — only with your consent (where applicable).
privacy.s6: We keep data while your account is active and as long as necessary for the processing purposes or required by law. After you delete your account, data is deleted or anonymized within a reasonable period, except for data we are required to keep (e.g. for accounting).
s7: Under applicable law (including GDPR) you have the right to: access your data, correct it, delete it, restrict or object to processing, request portability, withdraw consent, and lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority.
To exercise your rights, contact us (see the "Contacts" section).
privacy.s8: We apply technical and organizational measures: connection encryption (HTTPS), storing passwords as hashes, access tokens in secure cookies, rate limiting, access control. Nevertheless, no method of data transmission is completely secure.
privacy.s9: Students may use the Service. If you have not reached the age at which you can independently consent to data processing in your country, use is only possible with the consent of a parent or legal guardian.
privacy.s10: We may update this Policy. We communicate material changes via the Service or by e-mail. The date of the current version is shown at the top of the page.
privacy.s11: For privacy questions: topchannel1914@gmail.com or via the support form.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.intro: This page explains how to cancel a subscription and get a refund for Diklario paid plans. Payments are processed by Paddle.com Market Ltd, acting as merchant of record, so refunds are issued through them.
refund.s1: The free plan lasts indefinitely and requires no card. We recommend making sure the service suits you before subscribing to a paid plan.
refund.s2: If the service is not right for you, contact us within 14 days of your first payment and we will refund it in full, no questions asked. For customers in the EU and the UK this right is guaranteed by law.
refund.s3: You can cancel at any time. Paid features remain available until the end of the billing period you have already paid for, after which the account moves to the free plan automatically. Your data is not deleted.
refund.s4: After the first 14 days we do not issue partial refunds for unused days of the current billing period — you simply keep using the service until it ends. Exceptions are listed below.
s5: Duplicate charges or other technical payment errors.
A charge taken after you had already cancelled.
Extended service unavailability caused by us.
Any charge made without your consent, including fraudulent card use.
refund.s6: Contact us through the support form on this site. Include the email your account is registered with and the payment date. We reply within 3 business days.
refund.s7: Once approved, Paddle refunds to the original payment method. It takes 3 to 10 business days to arrive, depending on your bank.
refund.s8: We may update this policy. Subscriptions already paid for are governed by the version in force at the time of payment. The effective date is shown at the top of this page.
